taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-24, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1101.7 | 4.18 | 4.18
2 | 1144.4 | 12.44 | 16.62
3 | 549.8 | 0.62 | 17.24
4 | 173.3 | 7.65 | 24.89
5 | 2079.8 | 25.05 | 49.94
6 | 1111.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as KQHK-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-24, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-24 (Survey Area T)**

The 6-layer interpreted resistivity model reveals the following stratigraphy:
- **Layer 1** (0–4.18 m): 1101.7 $\Omega\cdot$m
- **Layer 2** (4.18–16.62 m): 1144.4 $\Omega\cdot$m
- **Layer 3** (16.62–17.24 m): 549.8 $\Omega\cdot$m
- **Layer 4** (17.24–24.89 m): 173.3 $\Omega\cdot$m (conductive target unit)
- **Layer 5** (24.89–49.94 m): 2079.8 $\Omega\cdot$m (resistive stratum)
- **Layer 6** (>49.94 m): 1111.4 $\Omega\cdot$m

Evaluating consecutive layer triplets gives:
- Layers 1–2–3 ($r_1 < r_2 > r_3$): **K**
- Layers 2–3–4 ($r_2 > r_3 > r_4$): **Q**
- Layers 3–4–5 ($r_3 > r_4 < r_5$): **H**
- Layers 4–5–6 ($r_4 < r_5 > r_6$): **K**

The calculated 4-letter sequence is **KQHK**, which accurately corresponds with the survey interpretation on file.

{"curve_type_stated": "KQHK", "label_issue_flagged": false}
